rules.sentence: In the absence of these features, bradykinin-mediated angioedema is more likely and may result from C1 inhibitor deficiency or angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor use.
Diagnosis is primarily clinical, and testing is generally low yield unless an allergen or bradykinin-mediated cause is suspected.
Atopic dermatitis is primarily a clinical diagnosis.
Laboratory tests and skin biopsies are not necessary, but they may help rule out other conditions.
